value.rationale: The newly published direct-product unitary Cayley general-position problem motivates the graph family. Despite maximal face dimension n-1, the full complex uniformly collapses to a simply connected 2D spine with cubic rank of integral two-sphere classes, yielding a natural complete infinite-family homotopy classification not inferable from an enumerator. The arithmetic q-prime subfamily is genuinely part of the same theorem rather than a relabeled added finding.
